findings.description: Using naive `new Date(dateIso).getFullYear()` caused receipts on Jan 1st (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:01Z) to evaluate to 2024 on any server running in a timezone west of UTC (e.g. UTC-5). Created `extractTaxYearFromDate` matching `YYYY-MM-DD` directly.
findings.remediation: Implemented and used `extractTaxYearFromDate` across all tax deduction engines and batch processors.

findings.description: Offline fiscal reconciler calculated `totalReceiptKop` as `cashKop + electronicTotalKop + advanceKop + creditKop`, completely omitting `certificateRub` / `certificateKopecks`. In multi-tender split payments with certificates, total receipt sum was undercounted, breaking accounting reconciliation.
findings.remediation: Added certificate tender parsing, receipt storage, and batch summary accumulation (`totalCertificateKopecks`, `totalCertificateRub`), included certificate in item hashing signature.

findings.description: FNS registry XML file identifiers in `taxDeduction.ts` and `familyTaxBatchEngine.ts` were generating suffixes with `Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)`, causing non-deterministic test failures and potential collision risk in high-throughput offline batch sync.
findings.remediation: Replaced with cryptographic/deterministic generator `generateFnsRegistryFileSuffix` and `generateFiscalBatchId` in `idGenerators.ts`.

findings.description: Family tax batch XML generator forced fallback `770101001` for KPP even when clinic was an Individual Entrepreneur (IP, no KPP), generating illegal FNS file IDs for IP practices.
findings.remediation: Made `_KPP` conditional on `clinic.kpp` existence in fileId generation, matching statutory FNS specifications.
